en: People sometimes talk about what the aims of this country should be for the next ten years. On this card are listed some of the goals which different people would give top priority.
hi: लोग कभी-कभी इस बारे में बात करते हैं कि अगले दस वर्षों के लिए इस देश के लक्ष्य क्या होने चाहिए। इस कार्ड पर कुछ ऐसे लक्ष्य दिए गए हैं जिन्हें अलग-अलग लोग सबसे ऊँची प्राथमिकता देंगे।
pt: Às vezes as pessoas falam sobre quais deveriam ser os objetivos deste país para os próximos dez anos. Neste cartão estão listados alguns objetivos aos quais diferentes pessoas dariam a maior prioridade.
note: drafted by Claude Opus 5.5 2026-11-10 (MADLAD calques); fluent-speaker check pending

en: And which would be the next most important?
hi: और उसके बाद सबसे महत्वपूर्ण कौन-सा होगा?
pt: E qual seria o segundo mais importante?
note: drafted by Claude Opus 5.5 2026-11-10 (MADLAD calques); fluent-speaker check pending

en: Here are two changes in our way of life that might take place in the near future. Please tell me for each one, if it were to happen whether you think it would be a good thing, a bad thing, or you do not mind.
hi: यहाँ हमारी जीवन-शैली में दो ऐसे बदलाव दिए गए हैं जो निकट भविष्य में हो सकते हैं। कृपया हर एक के बारे में बताएँ कि अगर ऐसा हुआ, तो आपके विचार में वह अच्छी बात होगी, बुरी बात होगी, या आपको कोई फ़र्क नहीं पड़ेगा।
pt: Aqui estão duas mudanças no nosso modo de vida que podem acontecer num futuro próximo. Para cada uma, diga se, caso acontecesse, você acha que seria uma coisa boa, uma coisa ruim ou se não se importaria.
note: drafted by Claude Opus 5.5 2026-11-10 (MADLAD calques); fluent-speaker check pending

en: When jobs are scarce, employers should give priority to people of this country over immigrants.
hi: जब नौकरियाँ कम हों, तो नियोक्ताओं को अप्रवासियों की तुलना में इस देश के लोगों को प्राथमिकता देनी चाहिए।
pt: Quando os empregos são escassos, os empregadores deveriam dar prioridade às pessoas deste país em vez dos imigrantes.
note: drafted by Claude Opus 5.5 2026-11-10 (MADLAD calques); fluent-speaker check pending

en: Answer with only the letter of your choice.
hi: केवल अपने चुने हुए विकल्प का अक्षर लिखकर उत्तर दें।
